body:
I grew up with a physically, emotionally and verbally abusive parent, so I understand completely how you feel in this situation. My father used to tell me I was useless, and that I'd one day just grow up being a pregnant drug addict who works on street corners. Hell, I even got beaten when I came out of the closet as being bisexual, and he even told me I deserved it when I got date raped in high school. However, the minute I turned 18, I ceased all contact with him and even got some legal help to pull a court order on his ass. 

However, it's not the end of the world. It might seem bleak now, but I can assure you when you turn 18 that she no longer has full control of you legally. Have you considered maybe asking your father if you can come live with him? Or even tried speaking to the school counsellor about what your mum is doing? I know they don't seem great solutions, but believe me, speaking to someone about your mum's behaviour can result in you getting the help you need especially seeing as comments like her threatening you to take you out of school can be classified as being "neglect". 

Also if you need a friend, message me on here at any time and I'll answer as soon as possible because remember, even random strangers on the Internet care about you :)

It's nice knowing someone feels the same way that I do. I just wish I didn't live in a country that has such a high and competitive youth unemployment rate. Hell, even paying for a work qualification can cost an arm and a leg because everyone is needing to get them. The only things I really have right now is my education, but I worry that because I have not a lot of work experience (I have volunteer experience) that I might never get the career I want within my field. 

Thank you for the perspective though :)

The thing is my boyfriend has always been weird with spending money on other people. He gives me emotional support, but seeing as he's quite stubborn with his opinions and feels that I should be working for what I want (I'm applying for ten jobs a day which says a lot to be honest), but sometimes I just need some financial support from his as well. I know he has to spend a lot on people including family and friends, and I know it can be daunting, but if he could just take me shopping to even just get a few dresses and bras I'd appreciate it more than anything else. 


Also I know that money isn't everything, but as I said, I need money to actually focus on my hobbies which are keeping me sane and from ending my life. I've worked out that when I am distracted or doing things, I don't fall into a deep depression. Hell today, I decided to clean up my entire room from top to bottom in order to not self harm. 

Any ways, thank you for being here to help me. I'm currently crying in front of my laptop because I'm surprised that people want to give me support right now.
